changes: Moves installed-update runtime restoration into Inno Setup, the component that authoritatively owns the successful file overlay.
On /update installs, Setup closes the still-open browser-hosted NewzDeck window after the new native helper is in place, before runtime restoration.
Existing background services are repaired and started by Setup after the new files are installed instead of depending on an external post-Setup coordinator.
The tray running/autostart state is captured before upgrade and the tray is restored after the service handoff.
NewzDeck is relaunched by Setup at ssDone after a successful in-app update.
The external update coordinator no longer performs a second elevated service-start/tray/app restore pass after Setup.
Release CI exercises the /update path and requires the upgraded service to be running and the tray process to be restored.
regression_guards: Preserves v3.6.11 SAB Ownership Continuity and Smart Import completion reconciliation.
Preserves v3.6.8 image-browsing performance and gallery-quality behavior.
Manual non-/update Setup installs do not auto-open the NewzDeck UI.
name: Installer-Owned Runtime Restore
